speaker: Penny
text: God, what is wrong with me? I'm not perfect.

speaker: Leonard
text: How much have you had to drink tonight?

speaker: Leonard
text: Are you sure that you're being drunk and you're being angry with Kurt doesn't have something to do with what's going on here?

speaker: Penny
text: Leonard, you are so great. Why can't all guys be like you?

speaker: Leonard
text: Because if all guys were like me, the human race couldn't survive.
